brief:
China's ambassador to the Palestinian territories has stressed that the Palestinian cause remains central to Middle East affairs and cannot be marginalized, the Ma'an news agency reported. The ambassador said the Palestinian question is fundamental to regional stability and international diplomatic efforts.

The comments reflect China's longstanding position on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, treating Palestinian statehood as a core issue rather than a peripheral concern in broader Middle Eastern geopolitics.
title: China's ambassador says Palestinian issue remains central to Middle East
